verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Over the skies of Bethlehem appeared a star
While angels sang to lowly shepherds
Three wise men seeking truth travelled from afar
Hoping to to find the child from Heaven

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Falling on their knees
They bowed before the humble Prince of Peace

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I bring an offering of worship to my King
No one on earth deserves the praises that I sing
Jesus may You receive the honour that You're due
O Lord I bring an offering to You

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
The sun cannot compare to the glory of Your love
There is no shadow in Your presence
No mortal man would dare to stand before Your throne
Before the Holy One of heaven

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
It's only by Your blood
And it's only through Your mercy, Lord I come
